title: Confirm a Construct from an Imported Sequencing Trace (CLI Tutorial)

catalog.notes: Offline Sanger sequencing trace tutorial: seq-trace import/list/show, seq-confirm run --trace-id, show-report and JSON/TSV exports using existing 3100.ab1, fake.ab1 and 48 bp construct fixtures with fresh state. ABI/AB1 and SCF import use magic bytes; SCF coverage is synthetic-only, not a bundled public SCF walkthrough. File-supplied confidence is not quality-weighted consensus or independent biological validation. Prerequisite: already-built gentle_cli.
